name: phylogenetic-alignment-model-selection
description: Prepare sequence alignments for phylogenetic inference and select the best-fitting substitution model. Alignment quality directly determines tree accuracy. trimAl and Gblocks remove poorly aligned regions that introduce noise. ModelTest-NG evaluates substitution models (JC, HKY, GTR for DNA; JTT, WAG, LG for protein) with rate variation (+G gamma, +I invariant sites) using AIC and BIC.
